summary.text: Elijah Behnke is a Republican member of the Wisconsin State Assembly representing District 6 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists his current term as beginning on January 6, 2025.

paragraphs.text: Elijah Behnke was born in Oconto Falls, Wisconsin, and graduated from Oconto High School in 2001, according to Ballotpedia.
His career experience includes founding and owning a cleaning company.

Behnke was assigned to the Rural Development Committee as chair, the Constitution and Ethics Committee as vice-chair, and the Agriculture, Consumer Protection, Environment and Mental Health committees for the 2025-2026 legislative session.
